source_note: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别
english_source_note: Riemann Integral and Criteria for Integrability
callout_id: 黎曼积分的定义以及黎曼可积的判别#6
english_title: Theorem 2.1.1: Cauchy Criterion for Riemann Integrability
statement_en: A function $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ is Riemann integrable if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$ such that for any tagged partitions $(P',\xi')$ and $(P'',\xi'')$ satisfying $\lambda(P'),\lambda(P'')<\delta_{\varepsilon}$, one has $$|S_f(P',\xi')-S_f(P'',\xi'')|<\varepsilon.$$
callout_body: 函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$是黎曼可积的，当且仅当对任意$\varepsilon>0$,存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得任意满足$\lambda(P'),\lambda(P'')<\delta_{\varepsilon}$的划分$(P',\xi'),(P'',\xi'')$都有$$|S_f(P',\xi')-S_f(P'',\xi'')|<\varepsilon$$
